entities.summary: Max Guazzini is a French entrepreneur and, until June 2011, the president of the Stade Français rugby union club in Paris, which competes in the Top 14, the top division of rugby union in France. Since arriving at Stade Français in the early 1990s, the club rose from the lower divisions of competition to become one of the most successful French rugby teams of the modern era.
